title: myrcia maximiliana
intro: Myrcia maximiliana, commonly known as "Gum-Boo" or "Quina", is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest, belonging to the family Myrtaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Myrcia maximiliana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which exhibit antioxidant, cytotoxic, and antitumor activities. The plant has been shown to possess potential in the treatment of various diseases, including cancer, due to its ability to inhibit cell proliferation and induce apoptosis in cancer cells.
